blocks.text: Genetic paigham (message) ke mawad mein tabdeeli ko mutation kehte hain. Mutations chhoti bhi ho sakti hain (maslan aik ya chand nucleotides ki tabdeeli) aur bari bhi (maslan chromosome ke bare hisse ya poore chromosome ki tabdeeli). Mutations natural (qudrati) bhi hoti hain aur induced (bahar ki wajah se karwai gayi) bhi.

blocks.prompt: Chhoti aur bari mutation ki aik aik misaal dein.
blocks.explanation: Chhoti: aik ya chand nucleotides ki tabdeeli (point mutation). Bari: chromosome ke bare hisse ya poore chromosome ki tabdeeli (chromosomal mutation).

items: Mutation: genetic paigham mein tabdeeli, aik nucleotide se le kar poore chromosome tak.
Do qismein wajah ke lehaaz se: natural aur induced.
